name: Reviling And Reproaching
overview: Scripture reveals that reviling and reproaching often arise in response to God's chosen or His purposes, as seen when Joseph's brethren mock him as a dreamer (Genesis 37:19) or when David is cursed by the Philistine and by Shimei (1 Samuel 17:43; 2 Samuel 16:7). These expressions of contempt are not only personal insults but carry spiritual weight, as God Himself pronounces judgment on those who oppose His anointed (2 Samuel 16:8). Even close relations, like Michal toward David, can reproach in ways that challenge God's work through His servants (2 Samuel 6:20). Such passages underscore the call for believers to endure reproach and reviling for Christ's sake, trusting in God's sovereign justice.
